changeSet.comment: Defensive GRANT EXECUTE on nexus_svc for the 12 combined-query functions this changeset just DROPped and re-CREATEd, matching vectors-005-6's / vectors-008-2's explicit-grant precedent: a fresh CREATE re-establishes only the PostgreSQL function-level default of PUBLIC EXECUTE, not any grant a now-superseded pre-DROP object carried, so the grant must be re-issued explicitly rather than relying on the PUBLIC default silently continuing to hold.
